subject: Urgent: Lakeside Sponsor Booth A7 - Emergency Ethernet Patch & Backup Presenter
messages:
From: Sunnyside Events Ops <ops@sunnysideevents.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@sunnysideevents.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Booth A7 network outage & candidate presenter delay

Hi Logan / Laura,

Quick update from the show floor: Booth A7 (Acme Analytics) lost its primary Ethernet trunk during load-in. The Sunnyside network team reports a damaged trunk in the riser near gate C; they've applied a temporary splice but throughput is severely degraded (50–60% packet loss on bursts).

Additionally, Claire Dalton (their scheduled 11:00 AM demo presenter) called — she's stuck at the airport with a delayed flight and is now ETA ~2:30 PM. She asked if we can:
- Provision a wired fallback for the demo (low-latency video + remote screen share); and
- Arrange an on-site backup presenter or a telepresence kit if needed.

I've attached floorplan photos and the patch diagram from the crew. Team is prioritizing A7 but wanted to loop you in for any vendor-side approvals or alternate presenter options.

Attachments: floorplan_A7_photos.jpg, Sunnyside_patch_diagram.pdf

— Tom Reyes
Operations Lead, Sunnyside Events
ops@sunnysideevents.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0148
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Sunnyside Events Ops <ops@sunnysideevents.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Booth A7 network outage & candidate presenter delay

Thanks for the heads up, Tom — and Laura, Marissa, Dylan, heads-up on an escalation at Acme (A7).

Priority checklist:
1) Network: Can we authorize Sunnyside to switch A7 to the private 4G uplink + bonded cellular router we contracted? If so, please confirm any cost impact to Acme (we should waive if demo is part of sponsorship deliverable).
2) Presenter: Claire is delayed until ~2:30 PM. Can Marissa coordinate a quick phone/Zoom dry-run with Claire if we use telepresence? Otherwise, identify an on-site backup from the Redwood demo pool to run a condensed demo at 11:00 AM.
3) Comms: Laura, please draft a short note to Acme with the fallback plan. Keep it apologetic but decisive.

I can field the sponsor note and sign off on cost waivers. If Sunnyside needs an explicit approval to flip the uplink, they can proceed — we will cover the connectivity surcharge.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dalton <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Booth A7 network outage & candidate presenter delay

Hi Claire — I heard you're delayed, hope travel smooths out. Quick note from Redwood: we have two fallback options and want your OK on preference.

Option A (preferred): Sunnyside will flip A7 to the bonded cellular router and we’ll run the demo from your laptop via Zoom. We will provide a plug-and-play webcam + wired audio for the booth, and a Redwood on-site engineer will stage the screen-share. This preserves the full demo.

Option B: If you're not able to present live, we can run a 12-minute condensed demo with one of our on-site engineers at 11:00 AM and record it for your team to review later.

Please reply with A or B and whether you can do a 10-minute dry-run at 2:45 PM if you choose to present live later.

Attachment: presenter_one-sheet_ClaireDalton.pdf

— Marissa Cole
Senior Field Events Producer, Redwood Inference
From: Sunnyside Events Ops <ops@sunnysideevents.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@sunnysideevents.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Booth A7 network outage & candidate presenter delay

Logan / team — proceeding with the bonded cellular router switch now; we've staged two SIMs and will bind across carriers for redundancy. Estimated time to stable: 18–25 minutes. No charge to Redwood for the emergency, per our day-of SLA, but we'll log the event for post-show billing reconciliation.

We will also bring a telepresence kit to A7 (HD webcam, shotgun mic, fallback HDMI encoder) as insurance. If you want us to route traffic through your private VLAN instead of the public cellular path, confirm and we'll request the VLAN punch-through from network ops (adds ~10 mins).

— Ops Team
Sunnyside Events
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dalton <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Sunnyside Events Ops <ops@sunnysideevents.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Booth A7 network outage & candidate presenter delay

Claire — apologies for the disruption. We have two fallbacks in place and Sunnyside is activating a bonded cellular uplink now (no cost to Acme). If you can still present at 2:30 PM, we'll run the live demo using your laptop + our telepresence kit. If not, we'll run a condensed demo at 11:00 AM with a Redwood engineer and capture the session for your review.

Please confirm which option you prefer. If you pick live at 2:30 PM, can you confirm you'll be available for a 5–10 minute prep call at 2:45 PM?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Field Events, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dalton <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Booth A7 network outage & candidate presenter delay

Hi Laura / team — Thank you for the quick coordination and for covering the connectivity. Flight landed early and I'm en route — see you at the booth. I can do the live demo at 2:30 PM and will be available for the 2:45 PM prep call (happy to do a shorter 5-minute check if that helps).

Appreciate the backup options and Sunnyside's fast response. See you soon.

— Claire Dalton
